BURSEVI:v10p184/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p184/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p184/r1.claim: Sakar symbolizes nature and the hell of the lower self, which explains the placement of the moon, night, and dawn imagery before its terrors.
BURSEVI:v10p184/r1.anchor: لأن سقر إشارة إلى الطبيعة وجهنم النفس

BURSEVI:v10p184/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p184/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p184/r2.claim: Kibar is the plural of kubra; Sakar is one of the greatest calamities and, if understood as definite, unparalleled in its magnitude.
BURSEVI:v10p184/r2.anchor: والكبر جمع الكبرى جعت الف التأنيث كتائه وألحقت بها فكما جمعت فعلة على فعل كركبة وركب

BURSEVI:v10p184/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p184/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p184/r3.claim: If the objection concerns the number of keepers, Sakar is a major proof of God’s power to subdue sinners from Adam to the Resurrection through a small number of guards; if it concerns the signs, it is one of the greatest signs.
BURSEVI:v10p184/r3.anchor: وإن كان منكرا لعدة الخزنة فالمعنى إنها من إحدى الحجج أكبر نذيرا من قدرة الله على قهر العصاة

QASHANI:74:36/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:74:36/r3.speaker: author
QASHANI:74:36/r3.claim: The hell of nature is a great calamity and warning, but it warns only receptive people who may gain virtues and approach heart and spirit, while others descend into bodily desire.
QASHANI:74:36/r3.anchor: بل للمستعدين القابلين الذين إن شاؤوا تقدموا باكتساب الفضائل

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p32/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p32/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p32/r4.claim: Nature’s manifestations argue for the Hereafter and expose heedlessness; the Qur’an warns so people can prepare, while evaders are left with stubbornness as their excuse.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p32/r4.anchor: An argument on the Hereafter from the manifestations of nature is presented

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p55/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p55/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p55/r1.claim: The Qur'anic warning verses complete the preceding oaths: their account of Hell describes a great upheaval, not a jest, so mockers are unfortunate.

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r1.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r1.speaker: قنبل عن ابن كثير
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r1.claim: Qunbul from Ibn Kathīr pronounces the hamza in لإحدى, like Abū ʿAmr; another report from Ibn Kathīr omits it altogether.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r1.anchor: قنبل عن ابن كثير: إنها لإحدى الكبر [المدثر/ 35] مهموز

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r2.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r2.speaker: قتادة
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r2.claim: Qatādah identifies the great calamity as Hell.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r2.anchor: وقال قتادة: إنها لإحدى الكبر: جهنم

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r3.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r3.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r3.claim: The regular easing places the hamza between hamza and vowel; outright deletion is non-analogical, though poetic elision supplies precedents, including al-Farazdaq's إثم.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r3.anchor: فأما حذف الهمزة فليس بقياس، ووجه ذلك أن الهمزة حذفت حذفا

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r4.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r4.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r4.claim: Deleting the hamza is especially weak because it leaves a word-initial consonant cluster, but the attached lām makes the word behave internally, like a single word with an eased hamza.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p339/r4.anchor: ولهذا لم يتخفف الهمزة أولا، لأن التخفيف تقريب من الساكن

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p330#2/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p330#2/r1.speaker: قتادة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p330#2/r1.claim: Qatada identifies this one of the greatest as the Fire.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p330#2/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله تعالى ﴿ لإحدى الكبر ﴾ قال هي النار

QUSHAYRI:v3p364/r11.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p364/r11.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p364/r11.claim: The phrase calls Hell one of the greatest calamities.

QUSHAYRI:v3p364/r14.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p364/r14.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p364/r14.claim: The warning also fears that darkness may return to hearts after reality has been disclosed.
QUSHAYRI:v3p364/r14.anchor: من باب التخويف من عودة الظلم إلى القلوب

SULAMI:v2p359#5/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p359#5/r1.speaker: author
SULAMI:v2p359#5/r1.claim: The great warning is a warning against returning to injustice; the warning to humanity confirms the matter for those granted direct illumination.
SULAMI:v2p359#5/r1.anchor: أي لإحدى العظائم في باب التحذير عن عود الظلم

SULAMI:v2p359#5/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p359#5/r2.speaker: الواسطي
SULAMI:v2p359#5/r2.claim: When lights appear to the spirits of the unifiers, prophetic warning returns those absorbed in conformity to their witness; at direct vision, conformity itself has no significance.
SULAMI:v2p359#5/r2.anchor: قال الواسطي : معناه إذا اظهر على أرواح الموحدين الأنوار

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r10.claim: The apparent antecedent of ‘it’ is Hell; alternatives are the warning or the affair of the Hereafter, or the Resurrection as an unmentioned antecedent.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r10.anchor: الظاهر أن الضمير في إنها عائد على النار. قيل: ويحتمل أن يكون للنذارة، وأمر الآخرة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r11.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r11.claim: One of the greatest means one of the immense calamities or punishments, with no equal; al-kubar is the plural of al-kubra.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r11.anchor: ومعنى إحدى الكبر: الدواهي الكبر، أي لا نظير لها

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r12.speaker: الراجز
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r12.claim: The cited rajaz line uses ‘one of the great calamities’ for a devastating misfortune.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r12.anchor: يا ابن المعلى نزلت إحدى الكبر ... داهية الدهر وصماء الغير

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r13.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r13.claim: Al-kubar is a plural of kubra with the feminine alif dropped; the book of Ibn ʿAtiyya instead says it is the plural of kabira, likely a copyist’s error.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r13.anchor: والكبر جمع الكبرى، طرحت ألف التأنيث في الجمع

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r14.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r14.speaker: نصر بن عاصم وابن محيصن ووهب بن جرير عن ابن كثير
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r14.claim: They omit the hamza in li-ihda; the omission is irregular, while the normal easing of this hamza is an intermediate pronunciation.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r14.anchor: وقرأ نصر بن عاصم وابن محيصن ووهب بن جرير عن ابن كثير: بحذف الهمزة، وهو حذف لا ينقاس

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r15.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r15.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r15.claim: The apparent syntax makes the clause the answer to the oath; al-Zamakhshari alternatively makes it explain kalla, with the oath parenthetical for emphasis.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p335/r15.anchor: والظاهر أن هذه الجملة جواب للقسم. وقال الزمخشري: أو تعليل لكلا

FARRA:v3p203/r1.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p203/r1.speaker: أبي
FARRA:v3p203/r1.claim: Ubayy's reading has the nominative singular nadhīrun lil-bashar, “a warner to humankind”; both readings are sound.
FARRA:v3p203/r1.anchor: وفي قراءة أبي: «نذير للبشر» وكل صواب.

FARRA:v3p204/r9.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p204/r9.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p204/r9.claim: He instead connects nadhīran with “one of the great calamities,” treating it as an indefinite accusative separated from a definite noun, or as a verbal noun of warning.
FARRA:v3p204/r9.anchor: ونصبه من قوله: «إنها لإحدى الكبر نذيرا» تقطعه من المعرفة

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p497#3/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p497#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p497#3/r1.claim: Kibar is the plural of kubrā, as ūlā relates to awwal and sughrā to sughr; the phrase means one of the great calamities.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p497#3/r1.anchor: {إنها لإحدى الكبر} جمع "كبرى". مثل الأولى والأول، والصغرى والصغر.

ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r1.claim: The clause may answer the oath; alternatively كلا rebukes the denier, and the clause explains the rebuke while the oath is parenthetical or has an implied answer.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r1.anchor: جواب للقسم وجوز أن يكون كلا ردعا لمن ينكر أن تكون إحدى الكبرى

ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r2.claim: The pronoun refers to Saqar; الكبر is the plural of الكبرى, analogized to other feminine forms ending in alif.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r2.anchor: وضمير أنها لسقر والكبر جمع الكبرى وجعلت ألف التأنيث كتائها

ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r3.claim: Ibn Atiyya's claim that الكبر is the plural of كبيرة is mistaken.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r3.anchor: وقول ابن عطية الكبر جمع كبيرة وهم كما لا يخفى

ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r4.speaker: الزمخشري
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r4.claim: Al-Zamakhshari understands Saqar as one of the greatest calamities, among many large calamities; another reading makes it uniquely one of the greatest.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r4.anchor: على معنى أن البلايا الكبيرة كثيرة وسقر واحدة منها قيل فيكون في ذلك إشارة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r5.claim: The interpretation that many great calamities exist and Saqar is one of them better fits the context and hints at further tribulations.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r5.anchor: ورجح الأول بأنه أنسب بالمقام ولعله لما تضمن من الأشارة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r6.speaker: صاحب التيسير
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r6.claim: A further report takes Saqar as one of the seven levels of Hell; the author says this is not persuasive.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r6.anchor: وقيل المعنى أنها لأحدى دركات النار الكبر السبع لأنها جهنم ولظى والحطمة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r7.speaker: في البحر
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r7.claim: Al-Bahr offers the warning or affairs of the afterlife as possible antecedents for the pronoun; another proposal refers it to the Hour without a stated antecedent.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r7.anchor: وقيل ضمير أنها يحتمل أن يكون للنذارة وأمر الآخرة قال في البحر

ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r8.speaker: نصر بن عاصم وابن محيصن ووهب بن جرير عن ابن كثير
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r8.claim: They omit the hamza in إحدى, an irregular but light deletion of the hamza.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p130#3/r8.anchor: وقرأ نصر بن عاصم وابن محيصن ووهب بن جرير عن ابن كثير لحدى الكبر بحذف همزة إحدى

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p272#2/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p272#2/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p272#2/r1.claim: Saqar is one of the great matters; the singular of الكبر is كبرى.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p272#2/r1.anchor: {إنها لإحدى الكبر} يعني أن سقر لإحدى الأمور العظام، وواحد الكبر: كبرى

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p272#2/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p272#2/r2.speaker: مقاتل والكلبي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p272#2/r2.claim: They identify the great matters as Hell’s seven levels: Jahannam, Lazā, Hutama, Sa‘ir, Saqar, Jahim, and Hāwiya.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p272#2/r2.anchor: قال مقاتل والكلبي: أراد بالكبر: دركات جهنم، وهي سبعة

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:32-38/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:32-38/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:32-38/r5.claim: Hell is one of the greatest calamities; كبر is a plural of كبرى formed by analogy to its verb. The clause answers the oath or explains كلا, with the oath parenthetically emphasizing it.
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:32-38/r5.anchor: { إنها لإحدى الكبر } أي لإحدى البلايا الكبر أي البلايا الكبر كثيرة و { سقر } واحدة منها

NAHHAS:v5p70/r11.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p70/r11.speaker: أبو رزين
NAHHAS:v5p70/r11.claim: The pronoun refers to Hell; al-kubar means great matters and retains the article, so the word is diptote.
NAHHAS:v5p70/r11.anchor: قال أبو رزين أنها أي أن جهنم و الكبر بالألف واللام لا يجوز حذفهما عند أحد من النحويين

BIQAI-FULL:v8p233/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p233/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p233/r5.claim: The fire is one of the greatest calamities, or one of the seven immense levels of Hell; the author lists Jahannam, Lazaa, Hutamah, Saʿir, Saqar, Jahim, and Hawiyah.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p233/r5.anchor: أو المراد بها واحد سبع هي غاية في الكبر أي دركات النار

DURR-FULL:v8p335/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p335/r1.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v8p335/r1.claim: Mujahid identifies the great warning as Hell.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p320/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p320/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p320/r1.claim: The repeated البشر in this passage and لواحة للبشر is complete paronomasia.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p320/r1.anchor: وبين لفظ البشر المذكور هنا ولفظ البشر المتقدم في قوله : { لواحة للبشر } التجنيس التام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p320/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p320/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p320/r2.claim: كلا is a rebuke and rejection, usually responding to a claim by the same or another speaker; the cited passages illustrate this function.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p320/r2.anchor: { كلا } حرف ردع وإبطال . والغالب أن يقع بعد كلام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p320/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p320/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p320/r3.claim: كلا may be moved ahead to reject the preceding claim about the parable, with the intervening material parenthetical and the oath beginning a new statement; this permits a pause after كلا.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p320/r3.anchor: ويجوز تقديمه على الكلام إذا أريد التعجيل بالردع والتشويق إلى سماع ما بعده

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r1.claim: The opening waw may introduce an oath that concludes the preceding rejection of the claim about Hell's guards; إنها لحدى الكبر then explains the rejection, with its pronoun referring to Saqar.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r1.anchor: وهذا القسم يجوز أن يكون تذييلا لما قبله مؤكدا لما أفادته { كلا } من الإنكار

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r2.claim: Alternatively, the oath begins the following statement, and إنها لحدى الكبر is its response; the pronoun again refers to Saqar, the greatest of terrors.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r2.anchor: ويحتمل أن يكون القسم صدرا للكلام الذي بعده وجملة { إنها لإحدى الكبر } جواب القسم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r3.claim: The three oath clauses repeat emphasis, conventionally three times, and swear by a great created object and two great signs of God's power.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r3.anchor: وهذه ثلاثة أيمان لزيادة التأكيد فإن التأكيد اللفظي إذا أكد بالتكرار يكرر ثلاث مرات

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r4.claim: Moon, departing night, and brightening dawn are apt oaths because their lights appear amid darkness, evoking guidance and misguidance and the Qur'an's light.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r4.anchor: ومناسبة القسم ب { القمر والليل إذ أدبر والصبح إذا أسفر } أن هذه الثلاثة تظهر بها أنوار

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r5.claim: The night departs as dawn approaches, while dawn begins to show its light.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r5.anchor: وإدبار الليل : اقتراب تقضيه عند الفجر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r6.claim: إذ and إذا are time adverbs functioning circumstantially for night and dawn; the ordered transition from darkness to light recalls Islam removing disbelief, as in 14:1.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p321/r6.anchor: وكل من { إذ } و { إذا } واقعان اسمي زمان منتصبان على الحال

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r1.claim: The sentence is used like a proverb; إحدى means uniquely prominent among the greatest calamities, not merely one item in a group.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r1.anchor: وقد أجريت جملة { إنها لإحدى الكبر } مجرى المثل . ومعنى { إحدى } أنها المتوحدة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r2.claim: The comparison with one among the notable men and the proverb إحدى حظيات لقمان illustrates distinction and prominence.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r2.anchor: كما تقدم في قوله : { ذرني ومن خلقت وحيدا }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r3.speaker: نافع وحمزة وحفص ويعقوب وخلف
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r3.claim: These readers have إذ أدبر, with إذ and a past-tense form: the oath is by the recurring moment when night has departed.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r3.anchor: وقرأ نافع وحمزة وحفص ويعقوب وخلف { إذ أدبر } بسكون ذال { إذ }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r4.speaker: ابن كثير وابن عامر وأبو عمرو وأبو بكر عن عاصم والكسائي وأبو جعفر
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r4.claim: These readers have إذا دبر, with a future-time adverb and a plain verb meaning departed, parallel to إذا أسفر; both readings are sound.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r4.anchor: وقرأه ابن كثير وابن عامر وأبو عمرو وأبو بكر عن عاصم والكسائي وأبو جعفر { إذا دبر }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r5.claim: الكبر is an irregular broken plural of الكبرى; the form treats the word as the name of a great calamity rather than a feminine adjective, unlike عظمى.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p322/r5.anchor: و { الكبر } : جمع الكبرى في نوعها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r2.speaker: قتادة وأبو رزين وغيره
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r2.claim: Qatada, Abu Razin, and others say the pronoun in إنها refers to Hell.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r2.anchor: وقوله تعالى: إنها لإحدى الكبر قال قتادة وأبو رزين وغيره: الضمير لجهنم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r3.claim: The pronoun may instead refer to the warning or the affair of the afterlife, paralleling 38:67.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r3.anchor: أن يكون الضمير للنذارة، وأمر الآخرة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r4.claim: الكبر is the plural of كبيرة.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r5.speaker: ابن كثير ونصر بن عاصم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r5.claim: Most readers pronounce إحدى with its hamza; Ibn Kathir is also reported without the hamza, as read by Nasr ibn Asim.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r5.anchor: وقرأ جمهور القراء «لإحدى» بهمزة في ألف إحدى، وروي عن ابن كثير أنه قرأ «لاحدى» دون همزة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r6.speaker: أبو علي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r6.claim: Abu Ali says easing the hamza between full articulation and elision is regular, while deleting it is non-analogical though attested in poetry.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r6.anchor: قال أبو علي: التخفيف في لإحدى الكبر، أن تجعل الهمزة فيها بين بين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r7.speaker: أبو الأسود الدؤلي وثعلب
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r7.claim: Abu al-Aswad al-Duʾali and Thaʿlab cite verses that attest dropping the hamza.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p397#2/r7.anchor: وقد جاء حذفها. قال أبو الأسود الدؤلي: [الكامل]

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p410#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p410#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p410#2/r1.claim: The pronoun refers to Saqar, and al-kubar is the plural of kubrā, like al-ṣighar and al-ṣughrā; the sense is one of the great calamities.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p410#2/r1.anchor: إنها يعني سقر لإحدى الكبر قال ابن قتيبة الكبر جمع كبرى مثل الأول والأولى

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p410#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p410#2/r2.speaker: الحسن
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p410#2/r2.claim: Ḥasan says God has warned about nothing frailer than Saqar.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p410#2/r2.anchor: قال الحسن والله ما أنذر الله بشيء أوهى منها

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p410#2/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p410#2/r3.speaker: ابن السائب ومقاتل
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p410#2/r3.claim: They take al-kubar to mean the seven levels of Hell.

JISHUMI:v10p7165#2/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7165#2/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7165#2/r11.claim: Kubar is the plural of kubrā, following the pattern of awlā/awwal and ukhrā/ukhar.
JISHUMI:v10p7165#2/r11.anchor: والكبر: جمع كبرى، كما يقال: أولى وأول، وأخرى وأخر

SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r1.claim: The pronoun in ‘innaha’ may refer to Hell, the Resurrection, the warning, or be a pronoun of the matter; the Shaykh’s Resurrection interpretation has an unmentioned antecedent and a gender problem.
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r1.anchor: وقيل: إن قيام الساعة كذا حكاه الشيخ، وفيه شيئان: عوده على غير مذكور

SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r2.speaker: نصر بن عاصم، ابن محيصن
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r2.claim: The common reading has ‘li-ihda’ with hamza; Nasr ibn ‘Asim and Ibn Muhaysin, with a report from Ibn Kathir, read ‘li-hada’ without it, an exceptional form not suitable as a productive analogy.
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r2.anchor: وقرأ نصر بن عاصم وابن محيصن، وتروى عن ابن كثير " لحدى " بحذف الهمزة

SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r3.claim: The exceptional form may be explained by changing hamza to alif and deleting the alif when two vowelless letters meet; regular easing would instead place the hamza between hamza and alif.
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r3.anchor: وتوجيهه: أن يكون أبدلها ألفا، ثم حذفت الألف لالتقاء الساكنين

SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r4.claim: ‘One of the greatest calamities’ means one of the great disasters; the cited verse by Ibn al-Mu‘alla witnesses the phrase, while kubar is the plural of kubra.
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r4.anchor: أي: إحدى الدواهي قال: 4395 يا بن المعلى نزلت إحدى الكبر

SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r5.speaker: ابن عطية
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r5.claim: Ibn ‘Atiyya calls kubar a plural of kabira, but the author suspects that this is an error.
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r5.anchor: وقال ابن عطية: " جمع كبيرة " وأظنه وهما عليه

SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r6.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r6.claim: The sentence may answer the oath beginning ‘by the moon’, or explain ‘kalla’ while the oath is an emphatic parenthesis; the author rejects the second as forced and contrary to the apparent syntax.
SAMIN-DURR:74:35/r6.anchor: أنها تعليل ل " كلا " والقسم معترض للتوكيد، قاله الزمخشري

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r16.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r16.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r16.claim: The great calamity may be their denial of Muhammad, a major sin.

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r17.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r17.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r17.claim: It may instead mean that the Fire is one of the great calamities.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r17.anchor: الثاني : أي أن هذه النار لإحدى الكبر , أي لإحدى الدواهي .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r18.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r18.speaker: ابن عيسى
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r18.claim: It may mean this verse is one of the great signs.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r18.anchor: الثالث : أن هذه الآية لإحدى الكبر , حكاه ابن عيسى .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r19.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r19.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r19.claim: A possible further meaning is that the Resurrection is one of the great calamities and punishments.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p145/r19.anchor: ويحتمل رابعا : أن قيام الساعة لإحدى الكبر , والكبر هي العظائم والعقوبات والشدائد ,

MUQATIL:74:34-52/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:74:34-52/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:74:34-52/r2.claim: Saqar is one of the seven gates of Hell, alongside Jahannam, Laza, Hutama, Sa'ir, Jaheem, and Hawiya.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p297#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p297#4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p297#4/r1.claim: “It” is Hell, and al-kubar is the plural of kubrā: one of the calamities, unequalled in greatness.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p297#4/r1.anchor: هي جمع الكبرى أي لإحدى البلايا أو الدواهي الكبر

QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r14.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r14.claim: The oath’s answer says this Fire is one of the great calamities; Muqatil says al-kubar is a name of Hell, while Ibn Abbas reports denial of Muhammad or the Hour as alternatives.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r14.anchor: جواب القسم أي إن هذه النار

QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r15.speaker: مقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r15.claim: Muqatil says al-kubar is one of Hell’s names.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r15.anchor: وفي تفسير مقاتل «الكبر»: اسم من أسماء النار

QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r16.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r16.claim: Ibn Abbas also interprets “it” as the denial of Muhammad, a great sin, or as the rising of the Hour.

QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r17.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:32-35/r17.claim: Al-kubar means the great and severe punishments; the cited rajaz verse uses kubar for a major calamity.

QURTUBI-FULL:74:35-37/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:35-37/r1.speaker: جرير بن حازم عن ابن كثير
QURTUBI-FULL:74:35-37/r1.claim: The common reading is la-ihda with a hamza, while Ibn Kathir is reported to read la-hda without it.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:35-37/r1.anchor: وروى جرير بن حازم عن ابن كثير «إنها لحدى الكبر» بحذف الهمزة

QURTUBI-FULL:74:35-37/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:35-37/r12.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:35-37/r12.claim: Kubra is the feminine singular corresponding to kubar, like sughra/sughar and uzma/uzam; its form is built directly for the feminine, not from a masculine base.

RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r1.claim: The sentence may answer the oath, or explain the preceding statement while the oath is parenthetical for emphasis.
RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r1.anchor: هذا الكلام هو جواب القسم أو تعليل لكلام والقسم معترض للتوكيد

RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r2.speaker: الواحدي
RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r2.claim: Al-Wāḥidī says the alif in iḥdā is cut off and retained in connected speech; Ibn Kathīr is reported to omit its hamza, as in waylamma, though this is not regular, and the expected form is easing it between hamza and vowel.
RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r2.anchor: ألف إحدى مقطوع ولا تذهب في الوصل

RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r3.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r3.claim: Al-Kashshāf explains kubar as a plural of kubrā by treating the feminine ending like tāʾ marbūṭa, citing analogous plural forms for dust and a burrowing animal.
RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r3.anchor: الكبر جمع الكبرى جعلت ألف التأنيث كتاء التأنيث

RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r4.claim: The pronoun refers to Saqar: it is one of the great calamities, with kubar glossed as the seven levels of Hell.
RAZI-FULL:v30p184#2/r4.anchor: يعني أن سقر التي جرى ذكرها لإحدى الكبر والمراد من الكبر

STUDYQURAN:74:35/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:35/r1.speaker: Q, Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:74:35/r1.claim: The phrase may refer to Saqar, which is one of the greatest calamities, or to the denial of Muhammad’s prophethood as a great sin.
STUDYQURAN:74:35/r1.anchor: Here it refers to Saqar (Q, Ṭ), meaning that Saqar is one of the greatest calamities

STUDYQURAN:74:35/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:35/r2.speaker: Āl
STUDYQURAN:74:35/r2.claim: Some infer from “one of the calamities” that calamities of this kind will be endless.
STUDYQURAN:74:35/r2.anchor: Some understand the assertion that it is only one of the calamities to mean that such calamities will be endless

STUDYQURAN:74:35/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:35/r3.speaker: Q
STUDYQURAN:74:35/r3.claim: Another reading takes the phrase as the disbelievers’ denial of Muhammad’s prophethood, one of the greatest sins.
STUDYQURAN:74:35/r3.anchor: It could also refer to the disbelievers’ denial of the prophethood of Muhammad, meaning that such denial is one of the greatest sins

TAB-FULL:v23p443/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r3.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r3.claim: Mujāhid identifies the “greatest matters” as Hell.

TAB-FULL:v23p443/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r4.speaker: أبو رزين
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r4.claim: Abū Razīn likewise says the reference is Hell.

TAB-FULL:v23p443/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r5.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r5.claim: Ibn Zayd identifies it as the Fire.
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r5.anchor: في قوله: {إنها لإحدى الكبر} [المدثر: 35] قال: هذه النار

TAB-FULL:v23p443/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r6.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r6.claim: Qatāda says it is the Fire.

TAB-FULL:v23p443/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r7.speaker: الضحاك
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r7.anchor: في قوله: {إنها لإحدى الكبر} [المدثر: 35] يعني: جهنم

TAB-FULL:v23p443/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v23p443/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās also says it is Hell.

TABATABAI:74:35-38/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r1.claim: The passage clears the Quran of the accusation against it: it is one of God's greatest signs and warns all humanity, freeing those who follow it from deeds that bind them to Saqar.
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r1.anchor: بيان في الآيات تنزيه للقرآن الكريم عما رموه به، وتسجيل إنه إحدى الآيات الإلهية الكبرى فيه إنذار البشر كافة

TABATABAI:74:35-38/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r3.claim: The author notes another possible function for kalla beyond the two readings just reported.

TABATABAI:74:35-38/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r5.speaker: بعضهم
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r5.claim: The usual view takes the pronoun in indeed it is one of the greatest as referring to Saqar, one of the greatest calamities, and makes the clause the oath's answer.
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r5.anchor: والمراد بكون سقر احدى الكبر إنها إحدى الدواهي الكبر لا يعادلها غيرها من الدواهي

TABATABAI:74:35-38/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r6.claim: The author allows the pronoun to refer instead to the Quran: the rebuke answers the claim that it is magic or human speech, and the Quran is among the greatest divine signs and a warning.
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r6.anchor: ويكون ضمير { إنها } للقرآن بما أنه آيات أو من باب مطابقة اسم إن لخبرها

TABATABAI:74:35-38/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r7.speaker: بعضهم
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r7.claim: Another analysis makes the clause a reason for the rebuke and treats the oath as an emphatic parenthesis with an omitted answer, or kalla as indicating the answer.
TABATABAI:74:35-38/r7.anchor: والقسم معترض للتأكيد لا جواب له أو جوابه مقدر يدل عليه كلا

TABRISI:74:32-56/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:32-56/r3.speaker: بعضهم عن ابن كثير
TABRISI:74:32-56/r3.claim: An anomalous reading transmitted from Ibn Kathir omits the hamza from ‘one of the greatest.’
TABRISI:74:32-56/r3.anchor: وفي الشواذ قراءة بعضهم يرويه عن ابن كثير أنها لحد الكبر بلا همزة

TABRISI:74:32-56/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:32-56/r6.speaker: author
TABRISI:74:32-56/r6.claim: Lightening the hamza makes it intermediate between hamza and a weak consonant; fully omitting it is not regular, though several cited poetic lines attest omission.
TABRISI:74:32-56/r6.anchor: التخفيف في لإحدى الكبر أن يجعل فيها الهمزة بين بين نحو سيم فأما حذف الهمزة فليس بقياس

TABRISI:74:32-56/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:32-56/r7.speaker: أبو الأسود لزياد
TABRISI:74:32-56/r7.claim: The poetic address ‘O father of al-Mughira’ witnesses omission of the hamza in poetic speech.
TABRISI:74:32-56/r7.anchor: قال أبو الأسود لزياد: يا با المغيرة رب أمر معضل

TABRISI:74:32-56/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:32-56/r8.speaker: الفرزدق
TABRISI:74:32-56/r8.claim: Al-Farazdaq's line on the sin of Atiyya and of the woman who warned him is another example of hamza omission.
TABRISI:74:32-56/r8.anchor: وقال الفرزدق: وعليك إثم عطية بن الخطفي واثم التي زجرتك إن لم تجهد

TABRISI:74:36-37/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:36-37/r11.speaker: ابن عباس ومجاهد وقتادة
TABRISI:74:36-37/r11.claim: The oath's answer is that Saqar is one of the greatest horrors; alternatively, the Quran's warnings are among the greatest signs.
TABRISI:74:36-37/r11.anchor: يعني أن سقر التي هي النار لإحدى العظائم والكبر جمع الكبرى وهي العظمى عن ابن عباس ومجاهد وقتادة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r3.claim: The pronoun refers to Saqar, already mentioned, which is one of the greatest calamities.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r3.anchor: يعني (أن) (¬9) سقر -التي جرى ذكرها- لإحدى الكبر

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r4.speaker: مقاتل والكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r4.claim: The seven great things are Hell's gates or levels: Jahannam, Laza, Hutama, Saʿir, Saqar, Jahim, and Hawiya.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r5.claim: Al-kubar is the plural of al-kubra, like al-sughra is related to al-sughar.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r6.speaker: المبرد وابن قتيبة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r6.claim: They understand al-kubar as great calamities, as in calling something one of the disasters.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r6.anchor: قال المبرد (¬7)، وابن قتيبة (¬8): إنها لإحدى العظائم، والعظم كما يقال: إحدى الدواهي

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r7.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r7.claim: Ihda is a feminine form used from the outset, not a feminine counterpart built from the masculine form, as with ʿasa and ukhra.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r7.anchor: و"إحدى" اسم بني ابتداء [للتأنيث] (¬9)، وليس بمعنى (¬10) على المذكر، نحو عصا، وأخرى

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r8.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r8.claim: The alif of ihda is hamza qatʿ and remains pronounced in connected speech.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r8.anchor: وألف "إحدى" مقطوع لا يذهب في الوصل

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r9.speaker: ابن كثير
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r9.claim: He reads inna-ha la-hida al-kubar, dropping the hamza, a deletion also illustrated by cited poetic lines from Abu al-Aswad, Ahmad ibn Yahya, and al-Farazdaq.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r9.anchor: وروي عن ابن كثير أنه قرأ {إنها لحدى (¬1) الكبر} موصولا حذف الهمزة حذفا

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r10.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r10.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r10.claim: The hamza deletion in Ibn Kathir's reading is not regular analogy; ordinary easing would make it intermediate, and deleting it leaves a word beginning with a consonant cluster.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r10.anchor: وليس هذا الحذف (¬1) بقياس، والقياس التخفيف، وهو أن يجعل بين بين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r11.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r11.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r11.claim: The weak reading can be explained because the attached laam is not separate, making the deletion internal to the word, like easing lahu or ʿuḍudan.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p445/r11.anchor: وجهه على ضعفه: أن اللام اللاحقة أول الكلمة لما لم تفرد صار بمنزلة ما هو من نفس الكلمة

ELMALILI:74:32-56/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:74:32-56/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:74:32-56/r2.claim: The seqar is one of the greatest calamities.
ELMALILI:74:32-56/r2.anchor: her hâlde kübrâların birisidir. Yani en büyük beliyyelerin birisidir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:32/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:32/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:32/r1.claim: The oaths by the moon, departing night, and dawning morning draw attention both to divine signs and to the importance of the warning to humanity.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:32/r1.anchor: Yüce Allah gece karanlığında dünyayı aydınlatan ay, aydınlanmak üzere olan gece, aydınlanıp ışığı her tarafa yayılmış olan sabah üzerine yemin ederek

FARRA:v3p205/r2.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p205/r2.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p205/r2.anchor: وقوله عز وجل: إنها لإحدى الكبر (35) . الهاء كناية عن جهنم.

JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p200/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p200/r1.speaker: author
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p200/r1.claim: A phrase’s rhetorical merit lies in the added nuance its arrangement creates: كأن زيدا الأسد conveys a stronger comparison than زيد كالأسد, as if Zayd’s bravery made him indistinguishable from a lion.
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p200/r1.anchor: وإذا لم يكن إلى الشك سبيل أن ذلك كان بالنظم فاجعله العبرة في الكلام كله

BURHAN:v4p172/r6.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p172/r6.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p172/r6.claim: The feminine فعلى form follows the same restriction as afعل: it is used with من, a construct, or the definite article; the cited forms show its definite feminine uses.
BURHAN:v4p172/r6.anchor: وحكم فعلى حكم أفعل لا يستعمل بغير من إلا مضافا أو معرفا بأل

MAJAZ:v1p10#2/r7.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v1p10#2/r7.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v1p10#2/r7.claim: Repetition emphasizes: the text repeats ‘I saw’ and ‘awlā laka,’ restates three plus seven as ten, and reiterates Abu Lahab's curse.
MAJAZ:v1p10#2/r7.anchor: ومن مجاز المكرر للتوكيد قال: «رأيت أحد عشر كوكبا والشمس والقمر رأيتهم لي ساجدين» (12/ 4) ، أعاد الرؤية.

DURR-FULL:v8p334/r15.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p334/r15.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p334/r15.claim: Qatadah says the dawn has brightened and identifies one of the great calamities as the Fire.
DURR-FULL:v8p334/r15.anchor: عن قتادة {والصبح إذا أسفر} قال: إذا أضاء {إنها لإحدى الكبر} قال: النار

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p272#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p272#2/r5.speaker: ابن عباس ومجاهد وقتادة والضحاك
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p272#2/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, Qatada, al-Dahhak, and other early authorities say that “one of the gravest” refers to Hell.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p272#2/r5.anchor: إنها لإحدى الكبر} أي: العظائم، يعني: النار، قاله ابن عباس، ومجاهد، وقتادة، والضحاك
